caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the distribution of samples across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The chart consists of a concentric, dual-ring pie chart with a total of nine slices representing different categories. The outer ring contains four slices, labeled “Std: 0.0” (dark blue, 7.0%), “Std: 0.47” (blue, 47.7%), “Std: 0.82” (light blue, 49.0%), and “Std: 0.94” (bright blue, 5.0%). The inner ring contains three slices, labeled “Max: 1” (light teal, 14.2%), “Max: 2” (teal, 39.0%), and “Max: 3” (dark teal, 38.0%). The chart includes a legend with color associations for each category, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered by descending proportion within each ring, starting with the largest slice and moving clockwise.
